entities.summary: Han Qide is a Chinese physician and politician. Han served as the chairman of the Jiusan Society and is a member of the Chinese Communist Party. He was the vice chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and served as the vice chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference. He also served as the president of the China Association for Science and Technology.
